messages:
Jamie L: Quick postmortem follow-up for the private customer 'Aster' — focusing on VPC peering flaps and on‑prem isolation bugs. Root cause: intermittent route propagation on customer's edge appliance.
Raja P: Thanks. Added notes from the oncall: we saw BGP session oscillation after peering refresh.
Tess H: Recommended next step: schedule vendor time to capture tcpdump and config snapshot. Owner: Tess. Target: 2024-11-15.
Jamie L: Action list (short):
- Tess H -> vendor capture + config snapshot (by 2024-11-15)
- Raja P -> add health-check probe & circuit breaker in routing shim (by 2024-11-08)
- Maria S -> update runbook and add triage playbook snippet (by 2024-11-10)
- Kevin B -> create a canary peering policy for Dedicated customers (by 2024-11-20)

Raja P: +1 to canary peering; suggest we gate on session stability metric > 99.9% over 24h.
Maria S: I'll add a new section 'onprem/vpc-peering-flap' to the runbook and include log commands.
Kevin B: Creating an RFC for canary peering, will post in #eng-platform tomorrow.
ops-bot: incident updated — labels: remediation-assigned, vpc-peering, onprem
Tess H: Quick excerpt of suggested playbook to add to runbook:
```
# peering-stability-check
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$VPC" | jq '.'
# check BGP sessions on edge appliance
ssh admin@$PEER_IP 'show bgp summary'
```
Raja P: Note — recurring pattern: 3rd-party edge appliances with aggressive aging -> replays every ~6 weeks. We should add a monitoring alert for route oscillation (sig: RO-PEER-01).
Jamie L: Agree. New metric + alert: RO-PEER-01. Owner: Raja. ETA: 2024-11-07.
Maria S: For remediation ownership, propose quarterly rotation for 'peering shepherd' between eng-sre and eng-platform.
Kevin B: +1. Also propose a small automation: detect repeated customer-initiated peering refresh and auto-mute alerts + create ticket template.
Jamie L: OK, owners and timelines locked. I'll compile into the postmortem follow-up doc and ping customer success for a sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria S: I'll schedule a 30m customer sync for 2024-11-16 14:00 PT — invite going out.
Raja P: I'll start instrumenting the circuit breaker prototype this week.
Tess H: Uploading packet captures to the incident folder once vendor session complete.
Kevin B: RFC link: <https://redwood.internal/rfc/canary-peering-2024> (will update when ready)
Jamie L: Closing checklist: update runbook, deploy probe, create metric, schedule customer sync. If anyone needs help ping me.
Maria S: Marking action items done in tracker as we go. :white_check_mark:
